Name: Martial
Theme: Shield-bearers and sworn blades who hold the line: taunt, guard an ally, shove, rally, then one decisive cut.

Name: Brawn
Theme: Fists, clubs and swords in motion: chained combos, parries, staggers and reckless swings that trade blood for damage.

Name: Shadow
Theme: Thieves, ninjas and blurs: vanish, flank, strike the opening and be gone before the reply.

Name: Wild
Theme: Beasts and the ones who run beside them: roars, pack rallies, snares and shots from afar.

Name: Brains
Theme: Builders, tamers and spellwrights: mines, turrets, tamed monsters, raw spells and the tempo of the fight.

Name: Grace
Theme: Menders and the sworn of light and dark: wards, cleanses, heals, curses that fester and drains that feed.
